title: Initialize a Megamono workspace
description: Add Megamono configuration, documentation projects, and baseline project tags.

survey.description: Print the deterministic workspace survey and exit without mutation.

dryRun.description: Print the selected module plan and exit without mutation.

format.description: Output format used by survey and plan reports.

only.description: Comma-separated modules to adopt: docs, agents, ci, release, lint, skills, health, inference.

interactive.description: Allow guided module, ambiguity, and confirmation prompts when attached to a terminal.

yes.description: Apply an explicit, fully resolved non-interactive plan.

report.description: Workspace-relative path for the optional completion report.

bootstrap.description: Run inside create-megamono's trusted new-workspace transaction without existing-repository Git checks.

platforms.description: Comma-separated platform vocabulary determined by a calling scaffolder.

ports.description: JSON object of application names to assigned development ports.

serviceRunner.description: Optional local service runner selected by the workspace scaffolder.

serviceRequirements.description: JSON object of service names to tested version requirements.

packageManager.description: Package manager selected by a calling scaffolder; existing workspaces infer it from their lockfile.

ciMode.description: Retain equivalent repository CI automatically, or generate a standalone or reusable Megamono workflow.

docsLoader.description: Workspace-relative Content Collections configuration used for repository docs.

docsModule.description: TypeScript import alias for generated repository-doc modules.

docsOutput.description: Workspace-relative generated Content Collections output directory.

docsLoaderMode.description: Create a Megamono-owned loader or adopt an explicitly selected compatible repository loader.

docsAdoptionMap.description: Workspace-relative reviewed JSON map of existing Markdown paths to complete Megamono lifecycle metadata; paths remain unchanged.

defaultScope.description: Scope tag value assigned to projects that have no scope tag.

defaultPlatform.description: Platform assigned to untagged existing applications.
defaultPlatform.x-prompt: Which platform should untagged existing applications use?

adoptionMap.description: Workspace-relative JSON file resolving per-project type and platform ambiguity.

toolchainPin.description: Optionally seed repository-owned Node runtime pin files.

toolchainNode.description: Exact supported Node version written by --toolchainPin.
